scope: Bound caller-supplied DXF CLASS row copies by count and aggregate retained string bytes.

countedPayload: recName, className and appName including one terminator byte each

behavior: Both const and move setters estimate the full row vector before staging or consuming it.
The const setter stages into a temporary and catches allocation failure. Rejected count, byte budget or copy input clears stale CLASS rows and latches refusal until corrected.
The writer checks pending CLASS setup rejection before output initialization; CLASSES preflight repeats the estimate before writing rows.
The existing CLASSES freeze rule remains in force, and a valid corrected setter clears rejection for a same-codec retry.

normalFocused.coverage: Exact and one-byte-under estimator boundaries, row-count refusal, rejected move caller preservation and stale-row clearing, injected const-copy allocation failure/retry, ASCII/Binary destination preservation and corrected same-writer retry, and neighboring source-table/no-raw regressions.

limitations: The estimate covers logical row slots and string payloads; it does not account for allocator capacity or process RSS.
This is a resource ceiling, not a DXF specification maximum or a support claim.
Moving setter bodies out of the public header requires consumers to rebuild/relink; ABI and packaging qualification remain open under P8.
next: Continue the P6 safety audit on other caller-owned copies and assembly/work paths.
